about: The load contract (all or nothing, A1 and A2; the owner's decision of 2026-11-28): every page file must load for the app to start. Any one that can't be loaded, doesn't parse, doesn't link or throws at load stops index.html's entry, so the start-up catcher fetches the files afresh and reloads once, then shows the start-up card (tests/retry.test.js).
files: every page script, in index.html's order. tests/modload.test.js fails on one not listed or one listed that isn't a page script.

layers: the import rule's layers, lowest first (A0's survey, ATOMIC-SURVEY.md section 2). A file in no listed layer is in `screens`. A page file imports only a file of its own layer or a lower one, or a file whose tag comes earlier, or (an import cycle's way back) a file that runs later and is read only inside functions.
lazy: a file a page file imports later with import(), not a page script; its failure once the app runs shows the toast "Something didn't load." (toast.js loadFailed).
optional: the sockets that stay optional by design (the survey's bucket iii): the asker can't import the server, because the asker also runs where the server doesn't.
workers: what a module worker's files may import (its closure): the files listed and the files in `also`, nothing else.

calparse.js.note: calendar.js calHere reads a feed on the page with import('./calparse.js') where no Worker can start; cal-worker.js imports it statically

look-on.why: core.js also runs in analysis-worker.js, which has no look-base.js: core.js asks whether the Look beta is on (served('look-on')&&ask('look-on')) instead of importing it

asm-worker.js.why: the painting worker's files import only each other, srgb.js and bus.js: an import of core.js, detect.js, photo-keys.js or app.js would run them in the worker
